# Approved source notes

## Supported facts

- Project name: Neighborhood Neurons.
- Participating classrooms: 24.
- Submitted drawings counted as of the latest approved spreadsheet: 1,842.
- Public opening date: October 3.
- The project combines student art with introductory neuroscience activities.
- A public webpage is planned but has not been published.

## Unsupported or unresolved claims

- No source establishes that the project is the largest in New England.
- No evaluation supports the claim that every child understands the brain better.
- `student-collage-final.jpg` includes student work and its public-display permission is still pending.
- Attendance, learning outcomes, and final online gallery size are unknown.

## Approval

Amy must approve the final copy and any public use of participant-created visuals.
